LanguageData.DSU.AdjustOutputDirection.Desc: Choose the cell this bus works on: its own cell or one of the four adjacent cells (e.g. a hopper or a conveyor).
LanguageData.DSU.DropDirection.Desc: Side of the DSU where items dropped from the Items tab are placed.
LanguageData.DSU.Max.Desc: When this is enabled, the Output Bus will stop taking items if either the stack is full, or the stack size is greater than or equal to X.
LanguageData.DSU.Min.Desc: When this is enabled, the Output Bus will return the outputted item to the DSU if the item has less than X stack size. It will also only take items if there are enough items in storage to exceed the minimum.
LanguageData.DSU.ForbidOnPlacing.Desc: Items pushed out by this bus are forbidden.
LanguageData.DSU.IItemsTab.Label.Empty: There are currently no items stored
LanguageData.DSU.IItemsTab.Caption: {0}: {1}/{2} stacks
LanguageData.DSU.BindPort.Desc: Choose the Digital Storage Unit this port is connected to. Applies to all selected ports.
LanguageData.DSU.PawnAccess.Desc: When disabled, pawns can neither take items out of this DSU nor haul items into it. Ports keep working.
LanguageData.DSU.Alert.LostLink.Label: DSU: port lost link
LanguageData.DSU.Alert.LostLink.Desc: A DSU port is not connected to any Digital Storage Unit. Select it and connect it to a DSU.
LanguageData.DSU.Alert.DsuNonHermetic.Desc: The DSU should be placed in a fully roofed room, but there is no ceiling or wall in the room.
LanguageData.DSU.Alert.DsuOverheat.Desc: If the temperature keeps rising, the DSU and its stored items will begin to receive damage. Disable the DSU or use coolers!
LanguageData.DSU.PlaceWorker.ProperRoomNeeded: The DSU should be placed in a fully roofed room
LanguageData.DSU.PlaceWorker.DsuNeeded: Must be placed in a room with a Digital Storage Unit
LanguageData.DSU.PlaceWorker.OnlyOneDsuNeeded: Must be placed in a room with only one Digital Storage Unit
LanguageData.DSU.Config.BaseDsuStackSize.Desc: Number of stacks a DSU can hold without data extenders.
LanguageData.DSU.Config.ExtenderStackIncrease.Desc: Extra stacks granted by every powered data extender in the DSU room.
LanguageData.DSU.Config.DsuPathingMultiplier.Desc: Multiplies the distance pawn -> DSU -> destination. Higher values make pawns use Access Points more often.
LanguageData.DSU.Config.EnergyPerStack: DSU energy consume per stored stack: {0} W
LanguageData.DSU.Config.EnergyPerStack.Desc: The changes will be applied within 60 ticks
LanguageData.DSU.Config.AccessPointReturnDelay.Desc: How long an item delivered to an Access Point waits (when not reserved) before it is sent back into the DSU.
LanguageData.DSU.Config.HeaterEnabled.Desc: Enables DSU heating mechanics. It begins to emit a lot of heat when working, which you have to take away. If the DSU overheats - itself and the stored items will be damaged. Stock up on air conditioners or freezers!
LanguageData.DSU.Config.AutoBoundDsu: Auto bound ports to single DSU
LanguageData.DSU.Config.AutoBoundDsu.Desc: If there is only one DSU on the map - all new ports will be automatically bound to it.
LanguageData.DSU.Config.CleanCellItemList: Clean cell item list over DSU
LanguageData.DSU.Config.CleanCellItemList.Desc: Hides the bottom-left mouseover readout while the cursor is over a filled DSU. Listing hundreds of stacks there every frame costs a lot of FPS.
